items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: They said, 'She's good, she's good!' So John said, 'Forget it; listen to her play.' So we went on with that and everything was fine.

ctx.x: Seymour and Jeanette. A strange thing happened. We came to New York - I think it was New York we had gone, either New York or Rochester, some place. So we were getting ready to rehearse. I'd always stand at the piano and look at it before I tackled it. I was just sitting there. So Seymour came out and they introduced - I don't think they introduced him to everybody. He just came out, because he was sitting there and was irritable all the time. He said, "What's that girl doing, sitting at the piano?" Nobody would…
